user.title: Select a rice cooker
user.description: {count} Chunmi rice cooker(s) found in the Xiaomi Home integration. Pick the one to add.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description:
Device: **{name}**
Model: `{model}`
State: {state}

Note: the cooker is a Wi-Fi device that sleeps. Status may not refresh immediately while it is asleep, and commands issued during deep sleep are queued by the cloud until it wakes up.

abort.xiaomi_home_not_configured: Set up the official **Xiaomi Home** integration first. This integration reuses its account session and cloud channel — no extra credentials needed.
abort.no_cooker_found: No Chunmi rice cooker found (model must start with `chunmi.cooker.`). Make sure the device is bound in Mi Home and synced to Xiaomi Home.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to actively poll the status. The device is push-based; this is only a safety-net refresh. Choose "no polling" to rely on push only.
data_description.use_lan: Bypass the official Xiaomi Home integration's mDNS discovery and connect to the device by unicast. That discovery uses multicast, which cannot cross subnets.
data_description.lan_ip: For example 192.168.26.179. When enabled, reads and writes prefer the LAN path and fall back to the cloud automatically.
